# PDF fixtures (phase 4 spike C1)

Made with `pdfkit` on macOS (Arial), not regenerated by tests:

- `vi-5pages.pdf`: five pages of Vietnamese text, a running head and a page number on each page.
- `nfd.pdf`: Vietnamese text written in decomposed form (NFD).
- `encrypted.pdf`: an open password (`secret`).
- `truncated.pdf`: `vi-5pages.pdf` cut in half.
- `bomb-400m.pdf`: one page whose Flate content stream inflates to 400 MB of spaces.

Scans and page counts are built in the tests (`minimalPdf` in `src/sources/pdf.test.ts`).
